description:
Extend the melting/solidification coverage in outram-foam-basic-lib beyond the already-ported enthalpy-porosity fvModel (src/fv_options/solidification_melting.rs).

Missing, per survey 2026-08-05:
- porosityModels::solidification (src/finiteVolume/cfdTools/general/porosityModel/solidification/) -- simple temperature-tabulated Darcy blockage, NO latent heat.
- fv::VoFSolidificationMelting (applications/modules/compressibleVoF/fvModels/VoFSolidificationMelting/) -- VoF variant keyed on a solid-fraction-vs-temperature table.
- A buoyant Boussinesq incompressible PIMPLE solver loop in outram-foam-appbuilder-lib that carries a temperature equation and applies fvModels to BOTH the momentum and the energy equation. pimple_foam has neither.
- Gau and Viskanta (1986) gallium melting verification case.
